annotations.title: Prashna accuracy against a shuffled-time control

description: Read-only. For resolved Prashna questions (outcome recorded as confirmed, partly-confirmed or not-confirmed), reports per question area how often the real-time Yes/No verdict matched what happened, beside the same question recast at random times within 30 days of asking. Returns n, hit rate, control hit rate, their difference and an insufficient-data flag under 20 scored cases. Aggregates only: no question text or tokens.

category.description: Limit to one question area, e.g. career

controlSamples.description: Random recastings per question for the control. Each is a full chart calculation, so at most 120 are run per call, newest questions first; the rest still count toward the hit rate (see controlledN).

limit.description: Most recent resolved questions to include

name: get_prashna_calibration
